basis: Disorder of hair shafts and pilosebaceous appendages; no other organ involvement defines the umbrella.
Autoinflammatory disease; cold-triggered inflammatory attacks do not establish persistent skin or other organ damage.
Developmental delay and intellectual disability define the syndrome; functional abnormalities of other organs are reported below 30%.
Biallelic RDH12 disease causes severe early-onset retinal degeneration; no additional organ disease is established.
Inflammation of the gallbladder wall; gallbladder belongs to the hepatic axis. Infection or autoimmunity is not intrinsic to all cases.
Carcinoma originates in the subglottic larynx. Thyroid invasion is possible, but involvement in at least 30% is not established.
Brainstem developmental abnormalities, congenital horizontal ophthalmoplegia and progressive scoliosis define the syndrome.
Intellectual disability, visual impairment and sensorineural deafness occur in 80-99%; leukemia is a separately diagnosed malignancy associated with the syndrome.
Localized eccrine sweat-gland disorder causing nasal hyperhidrosis with persistent erythema and papules; nasal skin is dermatologic.
Sarcoma of deep extremity soft tissues; lung metastases directly occupy lung in roughly 30-50% over the disease course.
Defined here as a psychiatric disorder; posturing and stupor alone do not establish damage to a covered organ.
Gonococcal infection defines the mechanism axis; the seminal vesicle is reproductive and has no anatomical axis.
Developmental epileptic encephalopathy with cerebral atrophy; optic atrophy occurred in 1/1 reported patient. Apnea does not establish intrinsic lung damage.
Dermal melanocytosis and cutaneous capillary malformations define the disorder; damaging ocular or neurologic involvement is not established above 30%.
Storage disease with cytopenias; renal protein loss 100%, nephrosis ~80%, cardiomyopathy/heart failure ~70-85%. Skeletal, neurologic, pulmonary and hepatic involvement omitted by cap.
Primary small-fiber neuropathy; peripheral neuropathy occurs in 80-99%. Episodic redness and warmth do not establish lasting skin or vascular damage.
Leukocyte aggregates obstruct microvessels; pulmonary injury and cerebral ischemic dysfunction each occur in roughly 30% or more of symptomatic cases.
Persistent arterial connection between aorta and pulmonary artery is a congenital cardiovascular defect; pulmonary artery involvement remains cardiovascular.
Proximal tubular wasting with metabolic acidosis defines disease; phosphate-wasting rickets/osteomalacia and fractures occur in 30-79%.
Benign fibroblastic proliferation occupies fascia and subcutaneous tissue; no metastatic or systemic organ involvement.
Malignant neoplasm involving the esophagus; no additional organ involvement is established across the umbrella.
GPI-anchor biosynthesis disorder defined by developmental impairment, seizures and distal phalangeal shortening; renal and ocular abnormalities occur below 30%.
Malignant tumor involving the cerebellum, a central nervous system structure.
Inherited Diamond-Blackfan-like red-cell production disorder; pure red-cell aplasia and steroid-responsive anemia reported in 1/1 patient.
Umbrella of primary childhood interstitial and developmental lung diseases; immunodeficiency or other organ disease is restricted to particular subtypes.
